title: To Write Is to Create
deck: Sometimes we write not because we have something to say, but because silence has become impossible. And sometimes what we put into words is precisely what we wish we could never have written.
author: Muhammad Aizaz Ahmad - Editor S&S
body: To write is to create something that does not exist, or to paint the black and white of existence with contrasting colours. Yet there are times when I cannot write, and this is one of those times. One must question: “Then how did you write this?” To which I must not answer, for I do not know what to say, nor what to think of it. All I believe is that I betrayed myself for something known as nothing—worthless, rotten from the core, and a home to fungus.Once dear to my heart, now a poison, a burden, a knife, and a blade to it; for which I feel a grief of immeasurable magnitude. Sorry if I may sound not very pleasing, as what I was, I never will be.
